mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal weakening corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises over the prior month, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 10.0 (thousands of units) signals a contraction in residential investment, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 10.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 10.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 115.0 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 115.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 115.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate indicates a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, which typically precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 190), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 190 and FEDFUNDS rises in the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 190 and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals an imminent labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and UNRATE rises in the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
